text.p: Colombia's peso slid 1.25 pesos to 1,130.05 against the dollar in trading dominated by banks, interbank traders said.
"The peso fell early on, then firmed on fears that there was a shortage of peso liquidity but then it fell again toward the end of the session," one trader said.
Banks and industry were demanding greenbacks and there were dollars flowing into the markets from foreign investment and petro-dollars.
The peso opened at 1,128 and went to an intraday high of 1,127.5 and a low of 1,130.5. Dealers reported 358 trades worth a total $163 million.
All markets and financial institutions are closed for a bank holiday Monday.
